item.title: NDSU to move from FCS to FBS and join the Mountain West Conference in football

item.title: SD Senate passes legislation authored by District 3 Sen. Carl Perry creating a new crime for witnessing a suicide and not attempting to call for help
item.description: (South Dakota Broadcasters Association) The South Dakota Senate passed legislation Monday creating a new crime for witnessing a suicide attempt without calling for help. Senate Bill 122 makes it a Class 1 misdemeanor to intentionally fail to summon aid when physically present during a suicide attempt. Supporters call it “Josh’s Bill” after a constituent case.
